d: At Al Tayer Insignia, your career is more than a job — it’s a journey into the heart of luxury retail. For over 40 years, we’ve partnered with the world’s most iconic brands, creating award-winning retail experiences across our boutiques, department stores, and leading online platforms. With stores and outlets across the GCC and a truly seamless omnichannel presence, we bring style, innovation, and heritage together. Here, you’ll join a diverse, customer obsessed, passionate team that celebrates creativity, values individuality, and empowers you to grow. Join us on our journey, reimagining fashion and redefining the meaning of luxury in the region.

SKIMS is a global fashion brand redefining shapewear, loungewear, and everyday basics through innovation and inclusivity. Co-founded by Kim Kardashian, the brand champions body diversity with products for all shapes, sizes, and skin tones. SKIMS is a fast-growing, culture-shaping brand known for bold ideas, meaningful collaborations and empowering people to feel confident every day.

As a Team Leader and Supervisor at SKIMS, you will play a crucial role in overseeing the daily operations of our store, ensuring exceptional customer service, and leading our team towards achieving sales targets. Your passion for our brand, strong leadership skills, and ability to create a positive shopping environment will drive the success of our store.

The Sales Advisor role is responsible for bringing SKIMS to life for our customers. This position contributes to a positive environment while delivering a best-in-class store experience. A passion for our products, genuine care for customers, and great service are at the heart of the job. The Sales Advisor represents the brand, inspires through styling and product knowledge, and aims to leave every customer with a memorable experience. Adaptability, teamwork, and enthusiasm are key — while also staying focused on achieving personal and team goals in a fast-paced environment.

As Visual Merchandiser, you will bring our brand story to life through creative, impactful displays. You will be responsible for ensuring that every corner of the store reflects the SKIMS aesthetic — from window concepts to product presentation — creating a memorable shopping experience for our customers.

As a Cashier at SKIMS, you are the final touchpoint of the customer journey and play a key role in delivering a seamless, elevated in-store experience. You will be responsible for accurate and efficient transaction handling, maintaining cash desk standards, and supporting customers with a warm, professional approach. Attention to detail, speed, and integrity are essential, along with a genuine passion for service. The Cashier represents the brand at checkout, ensuring every customer leaves feeling valued, confident, and excited to return.
q: Experience in a similar or customer facing role
Experience managing, leading and developing teams (for team lead and supervisory roles)
A passion for helping others and enjoys being a part of a team
Experience of working in a fast-paced, high volume, agile environment
Highly effective communicator, written and verbal
A fan of SKIMS our product, and our values
